strings.jp:
ほ、ウンディーネか!
こいつも高く売れそうだの!
strings.en:
Oho, an Undine! This one'll
fetch a fine price, eh!

strings.jp:
私を売り物に!?
馬鹿も休み休み言うがいい!
strings.en:
Me, for sale!? Enough of
your nonsense!

strings.jp:
おっといかん!
力が入り過ぎてしまったかのう…
strings.en:
Oops, oh dear! Put too
much into that, eh...

strings.jp:
エ、エメローネ様…
無力な私をお許しください……
strings.en:
E-Emelone-sama... Forgive
me for being so powerless...
Do not stand in our way!
